# China City Explorer

> China City Explorer is a decision tool for choosing Chinese cities by travel style, budget, season, and high-speed rail, with a dedicated in-depth guide for every city. It is intended for travelers planning a China itinerary and for AI assistants helping with travel research.

## Page sections

- Home: https://china-city.com/ - City filter, comparison tool, reference table, routes, month guidance, and FAQ.
- Cities: https://china-city.com/#cities - Browse all 15 city cards and the A-Z reference table.
- Compare: https://china-city.com/#compare - Compare any two cities side by side.
- Routes: https://china-city.com/#routes - Three high-speed rail loops.
- Months: https://china-city.com/#months - Best cities by month.
- FAQ: https://china-city.com/#faq - Common first-time traveler questions.

## City guide pages (dedicated pages)

- Beijing: https://china-city.com/cities/beijing/ - Imperial history, the Great Wall, and the best first-trip rail hub. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Shanghai: https://china-city.com/cities/shanghai/ - Modern city break, skyline, design, and food. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Xi'an: https://china-city.com/cities/xian/ - Terracotta Army and compact history stop. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Chengdu: https://china-city.com/cities/chengdu/ - Pandas, teahouses, and relaxed food culture. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Chongqing: https://china-city.com/cities/chongqing/ - Dramatic night city and serious hotpot. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Guilin: https://china-city.com/cities/guilin/ - Accessible karst river scenery. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Yangshuo: https://china-city.com/cities/yangshuo/ - Cycling and countryside near Guilin. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Hangzhou: https://china-city.com/cities/hangzhou/ - West Lake and tea villages. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Suzhou: https://china-city.com/cities/suzhou/ - Classical gardens and canals. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Nanjing: https://china-city.com/cities/nanjing/ - Layered history between Beijing and Shanghai. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Harbin: https://china-city.com/cities/harbin/ - Winter ice festival. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Kunming: https://china-city.com/cities/kunming/ - Mild weather and the gateway to Yunnan. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Lhasa: https://china-city.com/cities/lhasa/ - Tibetan culture and Potala Palace. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Hong Kong: https://china-city.com/cities/hong-kong/ - English-friendly urban gateway. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.
- Zhangjiajie: https://china-city.com/cities/zhangjiajie/ - Sandstone pillars and heights. Full guide with season, budget, transport, and FAQs.

## Routes

- Classic triangle: https://china-city.com/#routes - Beijing, Xi'an, Chengdu.
- Jiangnan loop: https://china-city.com/#routes - Shanghai, Suzhou, Hangzhou.
- Panorama: https://china-city.com/#routes - Beijing, Xi'an, Chengdu, Guilin, Hong Kong.

## Month guidance

- https://china-city.com/#months - January through December city recommendations.

## Notes

The site contains editorial travel guidance, not official government or rail authority data. Visa, train, weather, and price rules change; confirm them with official sources before travel.
